method: Built-in imagegen edits, one call per evolution; authorized deterministic pixel cleanup.
palette: Golden yellow eyes and accents, navy/blue body, near-black outlines, solid black pupils, no white catchlights.
format: 1254px transparent PNG masters; centered 512px portrait and 256px map WebPs and atlas regenerated by the existing asset pipeline.

stages.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing transparent 2D cartoon game demon sprite, color revision only.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve its approved drawing, silhouette, proportions, pose, expression, framing, line placement, internal shape boundaries and complete anatomy as closely as possible. Do not redesign, add detail, zoom, crop or change body proportions.
Primary request: make this Vi'Zel evolution have yellow eyes and yellow/gold accents, retaining its navy/blue main body and strong near-black outlines.
Eyes: flat saturated golden-yellow irises, solid black pupils connected to the upper eyelid as in the target; NO white dots, reflections, sparkles, glow or bloom. Do not recolor the black pupils.
Palette: golden yellow around #F4C52D, existing shadow planes ochre around #B5841F; blue/navy body colors and black outlines unchanged. Yellow should read clearly at small card size, never pastel or white.
Style: same restrained cartoon style as the provided target: bold near-black organic outline, broad matte color shapes, a few simple hard shadow planes. No realistic fur, glossy materials, metallic shine, 3D rendering, fine texture or added special effects.
Background: actual transparent alpha, no colored matte, no black background, no checkerboard drawn into pixels, no floor, puddle, cast shadow, props or text. Keep the entire character visible, all horns, tail and feet intact, with transparent margin. Deliver one square transparent PNG sprite only.
Stage-specific permitted changes: Recolor both red irises to saturated golden yellow. Recolor the small burgundy throat/chest tuft directly below the muzzle to warm golden yellow with a simple ochre shadow. Keep the two short dark horn buds, dark muzzle, navy hooves, blue body, tail and all other areas unchanged. Do not add forehead or body markings.
